title: Nanoporous palladium as a sustainable and temperature-adaptive nanozyme with oxidase-like activity for the detection of antioxidants
content: Nanoporous palladium from dealloyed Al–Pd alloy shows intrinsic oxidase-like activity, optimal under mildly acidic conditions. It follows Michaelis–Menten kinetics (low Km), generating reactive oxygen species to oxidize TMB. Antioxidants inhibit this reaction, enabling colorimetric detection. This work expands nanoporous metals as promising nanozyme platforms.
